units.literal: Li Song was a man of Raoyang in Shen Prefecture.

units.zh: 崧幼聰敏，能文章，為鎮州參軍。
units.en: As a youth Song was quick-witted and skilled at writing; he served as a staff officer in Zhenzhou.
units.literal: Song in youth was clever and perceptive, able at literary composition, and served as an aide in Zhen Prefecture.

units.zh: 唐魏王繼岌為興聖宮使，領鎮州節度使，以推官李蕘掌書記。
units.en: During the Tang, Li Jiji, Prince of Wei, served as director of the Xingsheng Palace and concurrently as military commissioner of Zhenzhou, with the legal officer Li Rao as chief secretary.
units.literal: In Tang, Li Jiji, Prince of Wei, was Director of the Xingsheng Palace and concurrently held the post of military commissioner of Zhen Prefecture; the legal officer Li Rao was put in charge of secretarial records.

units.zh: 崧謂掌書呂柔曰：「魏王皇子，天下之望，書奏之職，非蕘所當。」
units.en: Song told the secretary Lü Rou, "The Prince of Wei is an imperial prince on whom the empire's hopes rest; the office of drafting memorials is not one Li Rao should hold."
units.literal: Song said to the secretary Lü Rou: "The Prince of Wei is an imperial son and the hope of the realm; the duty of drafting memorials and reports is not what Rao is fit for."

units.zh: 柔私使崧代為之，以示盧質、馮道，道等皆以為善。
units.en: Rou secretly had Song draft the documents in his place and showed them to Lu Zhi and Feng Dao, who all approved.
units.literal: Rou privately had Song substitute for him and showed the work to Lu Zhi and Feng Dao; Dao and the others all deemed it good.

units.zh: 乃以崧為興聖宮巡官，拜協律郎。
units.en: Song was then appointed inspector of the Xingsheng Palace and promoted to Gentleman for Harmonizing the Pitchpipes.
units.literal: Thereupon Song was made an inspector of the Xingsheng Palace and appointed Gentleman for Harmonizing the Pitchpipes.

units.zh: 繼岌與郭崇韜代蜀，以崧掌書記。
units.en: When Ji Ji and Guo Chongtao marched against Shu, Song served as chief secretary.
units.literal: Ji Ji and Guo Chongtao campaigned against Shu, and Song was made chief secretary.

units.zh: 繼岌已破蜀，劉皇后聰讒者言，陰遣人之蜀，教繼岌殺崇韜，人情不安。
units.en: After Ji Ji had conquered Shu, Empress Liu listened to slander and secretly sent a messenger to Shu urging Ji Ji to execute Guo Chongtao; morale in the army grew unsettled.
units.literal: After Ji Ji had defeated Shu, Empress Liu, heeding slanderers, secretly sent someone to Shu to instruct Ji Ji to kill Chongtao, and popular sentiment grew uneasy.

units.zh: 崧入見繼岌曰：「王何為作此危事？
units.en: Song went in to see Ji Ji and said, "Why would Your Highness do something so dangerous?
units.literal: Song entered to see Ji Ji and said: "Why does Your Highness undertake this perilous act?

units.zh: 誠不能容崇韜，至洛誅之何晚？
units.en: If you truly cannot abide Guo Chongtao, what harm in putting him to death once you reach Luoyang—would that be too late?
units.literal: If you truly cannot tolerate Chongtao, what harm in executing him at Luoyang—how could that be too late?

units.zh: 今遠軍五千里，不見咫尺之詔殺大臣，動搖人情，是召亂也。」
units.en: Your army is five thousand li from the capital; to execute a senior minister without a visible imperial order will shake the troops' loyalty—that is how rebellions begin."
units.literal: Now the army is five thousand li from home; to kill a great minister without an edict seen within arm's reach will shake popular sentiment—this is to summon disorder."

units.zh: 繼岌曰：「吾亦悔之，奈何？」
units.en: Ji Ji said, "I regret it as well—but what can I do now?"
units.literal: Ji Ji said: "I too regret it—what can be done?"

units.zh: 崧乃召書吏三四人，登樓去梯，夜以黃紙作詔書，倒用都統印，明旦告諭諸軍，人心乃定。
units.en: Song then summoned three or four clerks, had them climb a tower and remove the ladder, and through the night drafted an edict on yellow paper, impressing it with the army commander's seal in reverse; at dawn he announced it to the troops, and morale steadied.
units.literal: Song then summoned three or four clerks, went up a tower and removed the ladder, and by night drafted an edict on yellow paper, using the commander-in-chief's seal reversed; at dawn he proclaimed it to the armies, and popular sentiment was settled.

units.zh: 師還，繼岌死於道。
units.en: On the march home, Ji Ji died en route.
units.literal: When the army returned, Ji Ji died on the road.

units.zh: 崧至京師，任圜判三司，用崧為鹽鐵判官，以內憂去職還鄉里。
units.en: Song reached the capital, where Ren Yuan headed the Three Departments and appointed him salt-and-iron administrative assistant; he later left office and returned home to observe mourning for a parent.
units.literal: Song reached the capital; Ren Yuan was director of the Three Departments and employed Song as salt-and-iron administrative assistant; he left office and returned to his home district on account of domestic mourning.

units.zh: 服除，範延光居鎮州，辟崧掌書記。
units.en: After his mourning period ended, Fan Yanguang, then stationed at Zhenzhou, engaged Song as chief secretary.
units.literal: When mourning was ended, Fan Yanguang was stationed at Zhen Prefecture and recruited Song as chief secretary.

units.zh: 延光為樞密使，崧拜拾遺，直樞密院。
units.en: When Yanguang became commissioner of military affairs, Song was appointed remonstrance official and served on the staff of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
units.literal: When Yanguang became Commissioner of Military Affairs, Song was appointed Reminder and served in the Bureau of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 累遷戶部侍郎、端明殿學士。
units.en: He rose through successive posts to vice minister of revenue and academician of the Duanming Hall.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Vice Minister of Revenue and Academician of the Duanming Hall.

units.zh: 長興中，明宗春秋高，秦王從榮多不法，晉高祖為六軍副使，懼禍及，求出外藩。
units.en: During the Changxing reign, Emperor Mingzong was elderly; Prince Qin Li Congrong repeatedly broke the law; Shi Jingtang, then deputy commander of the Six Armies, feared he would be implicated and asked to be sent out to a border command.
units.literal: In the Changxing era, Emperor Mingzong was advanced in years; Prince Qin Li Congrong was often lawless; Jin Gaozu was deputy commander of the Six Armies, feared calamity would reach him, and sought appointment outside the capital as a frontier commissioner.

units.zh: 是時，契丹入雁門，明宗選將以捍太原，晉高祖欲之。
units.en: At that time the Khitan raided through Yanmen Pass; Mingzong was selecting a general to defend Taiyuan, and Shi Jingtang wanted the assignment.
units.literal: At that time the Khitan entered Yanmen; Mingzong chose a general to defend Taiyuan, and the Jin high ancestor wished for the post.

units.zh: 樞密使範延光、趙延壽等議將，久不決，明宗怒甚，責延壽等，延壽等惶恐，欲以康義誠應選，崧獨曰：「太原，國之北門，宜得重臣，非石敬瑭不可也！」
units.en: The commissioners Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou debated the appointment for a long time without deciding; Mingzong grew furious and rebuked them; in their alarm they were ready to nominate Kang Yicheng, but Song alone said, "Taiyuan is the empire's northern gate and needs a senior commander—no one but Shi Jingtang will do!"
units.literal: The commissioners of military affairs Fan Yanguang and Zhao Yanshou and others deliberated on a general; for a long time they could not decide; Mingzong was greatly angry and rebuked Yanshou and the others; Yanshou and the others were fearful and wished to nominate Kang Yicheng for the selection; Song alone said: "Taiyuan is the northern gate of the state and should have a weighty minister—none but Shi Jingtang will do!"

units.zh: 由是從崧議。
units.en: The court adopted Song's recommendation.
units.literal: Thereupon they followed Song's proposal.

units.zh: 晉高祖深德之，陰遣人謝崧曰：「為浮屠者，必合其尖。」
units.en: Shi Jingtang was deeply obliged to him and secretly sent a messenger to thank Song, saying, "When one builds a pagoda, the capstone must crown it."
units.literal: The Jin high ancestor was deeply grateful to him and secretly sent someone to thank Song, saying: "In building a pagoda, the spire must be joined at the top."

units.zh: 蓋欲使崧終始成己事也。
units.en: He meant that Song should help him see the matter through to the end.
units.literal: He meant to have Song see his undertaking through from start to finish.

units.zh: 其後晉高祖以兵入京師，崧竄匿伊闕民家，晉高祖召為戶部侍郎，拜中書侍郎、同中書門下平章事兼樞密使。
units.en: Later Shi Jingtang marched on the capital with his army; Song hid in a commoner's house at Yique; Shi Jingtang recalled him as vice minister of revenue and appointed him vice director of the Secretariat, councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and commissioner of military affairs.
units.literal: Afterward the Jin high ancestor entered the capital with troops; Song hid in a commoner's house at Yique; the Jin high ancestor summoned him as Vice Minister of Revenue and appointed him Vice Director of the Secretariat, Concurrent Councilor of the Secretariat and Chancellery, and Commissioner of Military Affairs.

units.zh: 丁內艱，起復。
units.en: When his mother died he entered mourning, but was recalled to office before the mourning period ended.
units.literal: He entered mourning for his mother and was recalled before mourning was ended.

units.zh: 高祖崩，出帝即位，以崧兼判三司，與馮玉對掌樞密。
units.en: When Gaozu died, the Deposed Emperor ascended the throne and made Song concurrently head the Three Departments, sharing Secretariat affairs with Feng Yu.
units.literal: When Gaozu died, the Deposed Emperor took the throne and made Song concurrently administer the Three Departments, sharing command of the Secretariat with Feng Yu.

units.zh: 是時，晉兵敗契丹於陽城，趙延壽在幽州，詐言思歸以誘晉兵，崧等信之。
units.en: At that time Jin forces defeated the Khitan at Yangcheng; Zhao Yanshou at Youzhou falsely claimed he wished to return home to lure Jin troops, and Song and the others believed him.
units.literal: At that time Jin forces defeated the Khitan at Yangcheng; Zhao Yanshou was at Youzhou and falsely claimed he wished to return to lure Jin troops; Song and the others believed it.

units.zh: 初，漢高祖在晉，掌親軍，為侍衞都指揮使，與杜重威同制加平章事，漢高祖恥之。
units.en: Earlier, when Later Han Gaozu was serving Jin, he commanded the imperial guard as commander of the Palace Guard; Du Chongwei received the same concurrent appointment as councilor, and Gaozu was humiliated.
units.literal: Earlier, when Later Han Gaozu was in Jin territory, he commanded the imperial guard as commander of the Palace Guard; Du Chongwei received the same appointment as councilor, and Gaozu was humiliated.

units.zh: 怒不肯謝，晉高祖遣和凝諭之，乃謝。
units.en: In anger he refused to offer thanks; Jin Gaozu sent He Ning to remonstrate with him, and only then did he thank the court.
units.literal: Angry, he refused to offer thanks; Jin Gaozu sent He Ning to instruct him, and only then did he thank them.

units.zh: 其後漢高祖出居太原，重威代為侍衞使，崧亦數稱重威之材，於是漢高祖以崧為排己，深恨之。
units.en: Later Gaozu took up residence at Taiyuan and Chongwei replaced him as commander of the guard; Song also repeatedly praised Chongwei's abilities, so Gaozu took Song as working against him and deeply resented him.
units.literal: Later Gaozu went to live at Taiyuan and Chongwei replaced him as commander of the guard; Song also repeatedly praised Chongwei's talent; Gaozu therefore took Song as working against him and deeply resented him.

units.zh: 崧又信延壽之詐以為然，卒以重威將大兵，其後敗于中渡，晉遂以亡。
units.en: Song also believed Yanshou's deception; in the end Chongwei was put in command of the main army, was afterwards defeated at Zhongdu, and Jin perished.
units.literal: Song also believed Yanshou's deception to be true; in the end Chongwei was put in command of the great army, and afterward was defeated at Zhongdu, whereupon Jin perished.

units.zh: 契丹耶律德光犯京師，德光素聞延壽等稱崧為人，及入京師，謂人曰：「吾破南朝，得崧一人而已！」
units.en: The Khitan ruler Yelü Deguang attacked the capital; Deguang had long heard Yanshou and others praise Song; on entering the city he told his followers, "In conquering the Southern Court I have gained only Li Song!"
units.literal: The Khitan Yelü Deguang attacked the capital; Deguang had long heard Yanshou and others praise Song's character; when he entered the capital he said to people: "In conquering the Southern Court I have gained only Song!"

units.zh: 乃拜崧太子太師。
units.en: He then appointed Song grand preceptor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He then appointed Song Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 契丹北還，命崧以族俱行，留之鎮州。
units.en: When the Khitan withdrew north, they ordered Song to travel with his whole clan and kept him at Zhenzhou.
units.literal: When the Khitan withdrew north, he ordered Song to travel with his entire clan and detained him at Zhen Prefecture.

units.zh: 其後麻荅棄鎮州，崧與馮道等得還。
units.en: Later, when the Khitan general Mada abandoned Zhenzhou, Song returned with Feng Dao and the others.
units.literal: Afterward, when the Khitan general Mada abandoned Zhen Prefecture, Song, Feng Dao, and the others were able to return.

units.zh: 高祖素不悅崧，又為怨者譖之，言崧為契丹所厚，故崧遇漢權臣，常惕惕為謙謹，莫敢有所忤。
units.en: Gaozu had never liked Song, and rivals slandered him as having been favored by the Khitan; so when Song dealt with powerful men of the Later Han he was always timid, humble, and careful never to give offense.
units.literal: The high ancestor had never favored Song, and enemies also slandered him, saying Song had been treated generously by the Khitan; therefore when Song met Han power-holders he was always fearful and cautious in humility and dared not give offense.

units.zh: 漢高祖入京師，以崧第賜蘇逢吉，崧家遭亂，多埋金寶，逢吉悉有之。
units.en: When Later Han Gaozu entered the capital he gave Song's residence to Su Fengji; during the chaos Song's family had buried much gold and treasure, and Fengji seized it all.
units.literal: When Han Gaozu entered the capital he gave Song's mansion to Su Fengji; Song's household, amid the turmoil, had buried much gold and treasure, and Fengji took it all.

units.zh: 而崧弟嶼、{山義}與逢吉子弟同舍，酒酣，出怨言，以為奪我第。
units.en: Song's younger brothers Yu and Yan shared lodgings with Fengji's sons and nephews; when drunk they complained that their family home had been seized.
units.literal: Song's younger brothers Yu and Yan lodged with Fengji's sons and nephews; when drunk they uttered resentful words, thinking their house had been taken from them.

units.zh: 崧又以宅券獻逢吉，逢吉尤不喜。
units.en: Song also presented Fengji with the deed to the property, which only deepened Fengji's dislike.
units.literal: Song also presented Fengji with the deed to the house, and Fengji was all the more displeased.

units.zh: 漢法素嚴，楊邠、史弘肇多濫弄法。
units.en: Later Han law was notoriously harsh; Yang Bin and Shi Hongzhao frequently twisted it to their own ends.
units.literal: Han law had always been strict; Yang Bin and Shi Hongzhao often abused the law at will.

units.zh: 嶼仆葛延遇為嶼商賈，多幹沒其貲，嶼笞責之。
units.en: Yu's servant Ge Yanyu conducted business for him and repeatedly embezzled his funds; Yu had him beaten.
units.literal: Yu's servant Ge Yanyu traded on Yu's behalf and often embezzled his goods; Yu had him flogged.

units.zh: 延遇夜宿逢吉部曲李澄家，以情告澄。
units.en: Yanyu spent the night at the home of Li Cheng, a retainer in Fengji's service, and confided the affair to Cheng.
units.literal: Yanyu lodged overnight at the home of Li Cheng, a retainer of Fengji, and told Cheng the whole story.

units.zh: 是時，高祖將葬睿陵，河中李守貞反。
units.en: At that time Gaozu was about to be buried at Ruiling, while Li Shouzhen rebelled in Hezhong.
units.literal: At that time Gaozu was about to be interred at Ruiling; Li Shouzhen rebelled in Hezhong.

units.zh: 澄乃教延遇告變，言崧與其甥王凝謀因山陵放火焚京師，又以蠟丸書通守貞。
units.en: Cheng then coached Yanyu to denounce Song, claiming that Song and his nephew Wang Ning plotted to set fire to the capital during the imperial funeral and had sent a message in a wax-sealed ball to Shouzhen.
units.literal: Cheng then coached Yanyu to report a plot, saying Song and his nephew Wang Ning planned, taking advantage of the imperial tomb procession, to set fire and burn the capital, and also sent a message in a wax pill to Shouzhen.

units.zh: 逢吉遣人召崧至第，從容告之，崧知不免，乃以幼女托逢吉。
units.en: Fengji summoned Song to his residence and told him calmly; knowing he could not escape, Song entrusted his young daughter to Fengji.
units.literal: Fengji sent someone to summon Song to his residence and told him calmly; Song knew he could not escape and entrusted his young daughter to Fengji.

units.zh: 逢吉送崧侍衛獄。
units.en: Fengji sent Song to the guard prison.
units.literal: Fengji sent Song to the guard prison.

units.zh: 崧出乘馬，從者去，無一人，崧恚曰：「自古豈有不死之人，然亦豈有不亡之國乎！」
units.en: Song rode out on horseback; his attendants deserted him until not one remained; Song said in fury, "Since antiquity, has any man escaped death? Yet has any state escaped ruin?"
units.literal: Song went out mounted on a horse; his attendants left—there was not a single person; Song said in anger: "From antiquity has there ever been a man who did not die? Yet has there ever been a state that did not perish?"

units.zh: 乃自誣伏，族誅。
units.en: He then falsely confessed, and his whole clan was put to death.
units.literal: He then falsely confessed and his entire clan was executed.

units.zh: 崧素與翰林學士徐臺符相善，後周太祖入立，臺符告宰相馮道，請誅葛延遇，道以延遇數經赦宥，難之。
units.en: Song had long been friendly with the Hanlin academician Xu Taifu; when Later Zhou Taizu took the throne, Taifu told the chief minister Feng Dao and asked that Ge Yanyu be executed; Dao hesitated because Yanyu had been pardoned several times.
units.literal: Song had long been on good terms with the Hanlin academician Xu Taifu; when Later Zhou Taizu took the throne, Taifu told the chief minister Feng Dao and asked that Ge Yanyu be executed; Dao found it difficult because Yanyu had several times been pardoned.

units.zh: 樞密使王峻聞之，多臺符有義，乃奏誅延遇。
units.en: Commissioner of military affairs Wang Jun heard of this, admired Taifu's sense of justice, and memorialized for Yanyu's execution.
units.literal: The Commissioner of Military Affairs Wang Jun heard of it, admired Taifu's sense of righteousness, and memorialized the execution of Yanyu.

units.zh: 李鏻，唐宗室子也。
units.en: Li Lin was a member of the Tang imperial clan.
units.literal: Li Lin was a son of the Tang imperial clan.

units.zh: 其伯父陽事唐，咸通間為給事中。
units.en: His uncle Yang served the Tang and during the Xiantong reign held the post of remonstrance official.
units.literal: His uncle Yang served the Tang and in the Xiantong era was a Reminder.

units.zh: 鏻少舉進士，累不中，客河朔間，自稱清海軍掌書記，謁定州王處直，處直不為禮。
units.en: As a young man Lin repeatedly failed the jinshi examination; he wandered in the Hebei region, styling himself secretary of the Qinghai Army, and called on Wang Chuzhi of Dingzhou, who received him coldly.
units.literal: Lin in youth took the jinshi examination and repeatedly failed; he sojourned in the Hebei region, calling himself secretary of the Qinghai Army, and called on Wang Chuzhi of Ding Prefecture, who did not treat him with courtesy.

units.zh: 乃易其綠衣，更為緋衣，謁常山李弘規，弘規進之趙王王镕，镕留為從事。
units.en: He then exchanged his green robe for a crimson one, called on Li Honggui of Changshan, and Honggui introduced him to Prince Zhao Wang Rong, who kept him as an aide.
units.literal: He then changed his green robe for a crimson one, called on Li Honggui of Changshan, and Honggui presented him to Prince Zhao Wang Rong, who retained him as an aide.

units.zh: 其後張文禮弒镕自立，遣鏻聘唐莊宗於太原。
units.en: Later Zhang Wenli murdered Rong and seized power, and sent Lin as envoy to Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang at Taiyuan.
units.literal: Afterward Zhang Wenli murdered Rong and made himself ruler, and sent Lin as envoy to Tang Zhuangzong at Taiyuan.

units.zh: 鏻為人利口敢言，乃陰為莊宗畫文禮可破之策。
units.en: Lin was quick-tongued and bold; he secretly devised for Zhuangzong a strategy to break Zhang Wenli.
units.literal: Lin was a man of sharp tongue and bold speech; he secretly devised for Zhuangzong a plan by which Wenli could be defeated.

units.zh: 後文禮敗，莊宗以鏻為支使。
units.en: After Zhang Wenli's defeat, Zhuangzong appointed Lin branch commissioner.
units.literal: After Wenli was defeated, Zhuangzong made Lin a branch commissioner.

units.zh: 莊宗即位，拜鏻宗正卿，以李瓊為少卿。
units.en: When Zhuangzong ascended the throne he appointed Lin director of the imperial clan and Li Qiong as vice director.
units.literal: When Zhuangzong took the throne he appointed Lin Director of the Imperial Clan and Li Qiong as Vice Director.

units.zh: 獻祖、懿祖墓在趙州昭慶縣，唐國初建，鏻、瓊上言：「獻祖宣皇帝建初陵，懿祖光皇帝啟運陵，請置臺令。」
units.en: The tombs of the Exalted Ancestor and the August Ancestor lay in Zhaoping County, Zhao Prefecture; when the Tang was first established, Lin and Qiong memorialized: "The Exalted Ancestor, Emperor Xuan, lies at Jianchu Mausoleum; the August Ancestor, Emperor Guang, at Qiyun Mausoleum—we ask that platform directors be appointed."
units.literal: The tombs of the Exalted Ancestor and the August Ancestor were in Zhaoping County, Zhao Prefecture; when the Tang state was first established, Lin and Qiong submitted a memorial: "The Exalted Ancestor, Emperor Xuan, has the Jianchu Mausoleum; the August Ancestor, Emperor Guang, has the Qiyun Mausoleum—we request that platform directors be appointed."

units.zh: 縣中無賴子自稱宗子者百餘人，宗正無譜牒，莫能考按。
units.en: More than a hundred local troublemakers in the county claimed to be imperial clansmen; the Directorate of the Imperial Clan had no genealogies and could not verify them.
units.literal: More than a hundred riffraff in the county called themselves imperial clansmen; the Directorate of the Imperial Clan had no genealogical registers and could not investigate.

units.zh: 有民詣寺自言世為丹陽竟陵臺令，厚賂宗正吏，鏻、瓊不復詳考，遂補為令。
units.en: One man presented himself at the directorate claiming his family had for generations held the post of platform director at Danyang and Jingling; he bribed the directorate clerks heavily; Lin and Qiong failed to investigate and appointed him director.
units.literal: A commoner went to the directorate claiming that his family for generations had been platform directors of Danyang and Jingling; he bribed the clerks of the directorate heavily; Lin and Qiong did not investigate further and appointed him director.

units.zh: 民即持絳幡招置部曲，侵奪民田百餘頃，以謂陵園壖地。
units.en: The man then raised crimson banners and recruited retainers, seizing more than a hundred qing of farmland from local people on the pretext that it belonged to the imperial tombs.
units.literal: The man then took crimson banners and recruited retainers, seizing more than a hundred qing of commoners' fields on the pretext that they were mausoleum mound lands.

units.zh: 民訴於官，不能決，以聞。
units.en: The people sued in court, but officials could not decide the case and reported it to the throne.
units.literal: The people sued at court but no decision could be reached; the matter was reported upward.

units.zh: 莊宗下公卿博士，問故唐諸帝陵寢所在。
units.en: Zhuangzong referred the matter to the grandees and erudite scholars and asked where the tombs of the former Tang emperors lay.
units.literal: Zhuangzong sent the matter down to the grandees and erudite scholars and asked where the mausolea of the former Tang emperors lay.

units.zh: 公卿博士言：「丹陽在今潤州，而竟陵非唐事。
units.en: They replied, "Danyang is in present-day Runzhou, while Jingling has nothing to do with the Tang.
units.literal: The grandees and erudite scholars said: "Danyang is in present Run Prefecture, while Jingling is not a matter of the Tang.

units.zh: 鏻不學無知，不足以備九卿。」
units.en: Lin is ignorant and unlearned and unfit to hold one of the Nine Ministers' posts."
units.literal: Lin is unlearned and ignorant and is not fit to fill one of the Nine Ministers."

units.zh: 坐貶司農少卿，出為河中節度副使。
units.en: He was demoted to vice director of the directorate of agriculture and sent out as deputy military commissioner of Hezhong.
units.literal: He was demoted to Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture and sent out as deputy military commissioner of Hezhong.

units.zh: 明宗即位，以鏻故人，召還，累遷戶部尚書。
units.en: When Mingzong took the throne he recalled Lin as an old acquaintance and promoted him repeatedly until he became minister of revenue.
units.literal: When Mingzong took the throne, because Lin was an old acquaintance he was recalled and repeatedly promoted to Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 鏻意頗希大用，嘗謂馮道、趙鳳曰：「唐家故事，宗室皆為宰相。
units.en: Lin eagerly sought high office and once told Feng Dao and Zhao Feng, "By Tang precedent, imperial clansmen all became chief ministers.
units.literal: Lin greatly hoped for high appointment and once said to Feng Dao and Zhao Feng: "By Tang precedent, members of the imperial clan all became chief ministers.

units.zh: 今天祚中興，宜按舊典，鏻雖不才，嘗事莊宗霸府，識今天子於藩邸，論才較業，何後眾人？
units.en: Now that the dynasty is restored, the old rules should apply; though I am without talent, I once served in Zhuangzong's princely headquarters and knew the present emperor when he was still a prince—measured by talent and service, how am I behind the others?
units.literal: Now that Heaven's mandate is renewed, the old statutes should be followed; though Lin is without talent, he once served in Zhuangzong's ducal headquarters and knew the present Son of Heaven when he was still at his princely residence—comparing talent and achievement, how is he behind the rest?

units.zh: 而久置班行，於諸君安乎？」
units.en: Yet I have long remained among the ordinary court officials—are you gentlemen comfortable with that?"
units.literal: Yet he has long been left in the ranks of court officials—are you gentlemen at ease with this?"

units.zh: 道等惡其言。
units.en: Dao and the others resented his speech.
units.literal: Dao and the others detested his words.

units.zh: 後楊溥諜者見鏻言事，鏻謂安重誨曰：「楊溥欲歸國久矣，若朝廷遣使諭之，可以召也。」
units.en: Later a spy from Yang Pu came to discuss affairs with Lin; Lin told An Chonghui, "Yang Pu has long wished to submit to the dynasty; if the court sends an envoy to instruct him, he can be recalled."
units.literal: Later a spy of Yang Pu came to see Lin to discuss affairs; Lin said to An Chonghui: "Yang Pu has long wished to return to the dynasty; if the court sends an envoy to instruct him, he can be summoned."

units.zh: 重誨信之，以玉帶與諜者使為信，久而無效，由是貶鏻兗州行軍司馬。
units.en: Chonghui believed him and gave the spy a jade belt as credentials; after a long while nothing came of it, and Lin was demoted to acting military administrator of Yanzhou.
units.literal: Chonghui believed him and gave a jade belt to the spy as a token; after a long time there was no effect, and for this Lin was demoted to acting military administrator of Yan Prefecture.

units.zh: 鏻與廢帝有舊，湣帝時，為兵部尚書，奉使湖南，聞廢帝立，喜，以謂必用己為相。
units.en: Lin had old ties with the deposed emperor; under Emperor Min he was minister of war and on a mission to Hunan; when he heard the deposed emperor had taken the throne he rejoiced, certain he would be made chief minister.
units.literal: Lin had old ties with the deposed emperor; in the time of Emperor Min he was Minister of War and on a mission to Hunan; when he heard the deposed emperor had been enthroned he rejoiced, thinking he would surely be used as chief minister.

units.zh: 還過荊南，謂高從誨曰：「士固有否泰，吾不為時用久矣。
units.en: On his return he passed through Jingnan and told Gao Conghui, "A gentleman's fortunes rise and fall; I have long gone unused.
units.literal: Returning he passed through Jingnan and said to Gao Conghui: "A gentleman's fortunes rise and fall; I have long gone unused by the times.

units.zh: 今新天子即位，我將用矣！」
units.en: Now that a new emperor has ascended the throne, I am about to be employed!"
units.literal: Now that a new Son of Heaven has taken the throne, I am about to be employed!"

units.zh: 乃就從誨求寶貨入獻以為賀，從誨與馬紅裝拂二、猓犭然皮一，因為鏻置酒，問其副使馬承翰：「今朝廷之臣，孰有公輔之望？」
units.en: He then asked Conghui for valuables to present as congratulatory gifts; Conghui gave him two horses with red trappings and whisks and one orangutan hide, and over wine asked his vice envoy Ma Chenghan, "Among the court ministers today, who is likely to become chief minister?"
units.literal: He then asked Conghui for treasures to present as congratulatory gifts; Conghui gave him two horses with red trappings and whisks and one orangutan hide, and for Lin set out wine and asked his vice envoy Ma Chenghan: "Among the ministers of the court today, who has the prospect of becoming chief minister?"

units.zh: 承翰曰：「尚書崔居儉、左丞姚顗，其次太常盧文紀也。」
units.en: Chenghan said, "Minister of War Cui Jujian and vice director of the left secretariat Yao Hao; after them, Director of Imperial Sacrifices Lu Wenji."
units.literal: Chenghan said: "Minister of War Cui Jujian and Vice Director of the Left Secretariat Yao Hao; next would be the Director of Imperial Sacrifices Lu Wenji."

units.zh: 從誨笑顧左右，取進奏官報狀示鏻顗與文紀皆拜平章事矣。
units.en: Conghui smiled, turned to his attendants, and produced the memorial courier's report showing that Hao and Wenji had both already been appointed councilors.
units.literal: Conghui smiled, turned to his attendants, and took out the memorial courier's report showing that Hao and Wenji had both already been appointed Councilors of the Secretariat and Chancellery.

units.zh: 鏻慚失色。
units.en: Lin flushed and went pale.
units.literal: Lin flushed and lost color.

units.zh: 還，遂獻其皮、拂，廢帝終不用。
units.en: When he returned he presented the hide and whisks, but the deposed emperor never used him.
units.literal: On his return he presented the hide and whisks, but the deposed emperor never employed him.

units.zh: 初，李愚自太常卿作相，而盧文紀代之，及文紀作相，鏻乃求為太常卿。
units.en: Earlier Li Yu had risen from director of imperial sacrifices to chief minister, and Lu Wenji replaced him; when Wenji became chief minister, Lin sought the post of director of imperial sacrifices.
units.literal: Earlier Li Yu had gone from Director of Imperial Sacrifices to chief minister, and Lu Wenji replaced him; when Wenji became chief minister, Lin then sought the post of Director of Imperial Sacrifices.

units.zh: 及拜命，中謝曰：「臣叨入相之資。」
units.en: On receiving the appointment, in his thanksgiving address at court he said, "Your servant presumptuously possesses the qualifications for the chief ministership."
units.literal: When he received the appointment, in his thanksgiving address at court he said: "Your servant presumptuously possesses the qualifications for entering the chief ministership."

units.zh: 朝士傳以為笑。
units.en: Courtiers spread the remark as a laughingstock.
units.literal: Courtiers passed it around as a joke.

units.zh: 鏻事晉累遷太子太保。
units.en: Lin served the Later Jin and rose through repeated promotions to grand preceptor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: Lin served Jin and was repeatedly promoted until he became Grand Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 漢高祖即位，拜鏻司徒，居數月卒，年八十八，贈太傅。
units.en: When Later Han Gaozu took the throne he appointed Lin minister of education; he died several months later at eighty-eight and was posthumously honored as grand tutor.
units.literal: When Han Gaozu took the throne he appointed Lin Minister of Education; after several months he died at eighty-eight and was posthumously honored as Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 賈緯，鎮州獲鹿人也。
units.en: Jia Wei was a native of Huolu in Zhenzhou.
units.literal: Jia Wei was a man of Huolu in Zhen Prefecture.

units.zh: 少舉進士不中，州辟參軍。
units.en: As a youth he failed the jinshi examination and was recruited as a staff officer by his prefecture.
units.literal: In youth he took the jinshi examination and failed; the prefecture recruited him as an aide.

units.zh: 唐天成中，範延光鎮成德，辟趙州軍事判官，遷石邑令。
units.en: During the Tiancheng reign of the Tang, Fan Yanguang governed Chengde and recruited him as military administrator of Zhao Prefecture; he was later promoted to magistrate of Shiyi.
units.literal: In the Tiancheng era of Tang, Fan Yanguang governed Chengde and recruited him as military administrator of Zhao Prefecture; he was promoted to magistrate of Shiyi.

units.zh: 緯長於史學。
units.en: Wei excelled in historical scholarship.
units.literal: Wei was skilled in historical studies.

units.zh: 唐自武宗已後無實錄，史官之職廢，緯采次傳聞，為《唐年補錄》六十五卷。
units.en: From Emperor Wuzong of Tang onward there were no Veritable Records and the historiographers' office lapsed; Wei gathered hearsay and compiled the Supplementary Annals of the Tang Years in sixty-five juan.
units.literal: From Emperor Wuzong of Tang onward there were no Veritable Records; the office of historiographer was abandoned; Wei collected and arranged hearsay and compiled the Supplementary Annals of the Tang in sixty-five juan.

units.zh: 當唐之末，王室微弱，諸侯強盛，征伐擅出，天下多事，故緯所論次多所闕誤。
units.en: At the end of the Tang the throne was weak, regional lords were powerful, and war was constant; much of what Wei recorded is therefore incomplete or mistaken.
units.literal: At the end of Tang the royal house was weak, the feudal lords were strong, campaigns and punitive expeditions issued at will, and the realm was full of troubles; therefore much of what Wei arranged in sequence is incomplete or in error.

units.zh: 而喪亂之際，事跡粗存，亦有補於史氏。
units.en: Yet amid chaos and ruin some events survived in rough outline, and his work still supplements the historical record.
units.literal: Yet amid the chaos and ruin traces of events still survived in rough form, and it also supplements the historians.

units.zh: 晉天福中，為太常博士，非其好也，數求為史職，改屯田員外郎、起居郎、史館修撰，與修《唐書》。
units.en: In the Jin Tianfu era he served as erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices, a post he disliked; he repeatedly sought historiographical office and was moved to vice director of the directorate of agriculture, attendant of the heir apparent, and compiler in the History Institute, where he helped compile the Book of Tang.
units.literal: In the Tianfu era of Jin he was Erudite of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices; it was not to his liking, and he repeatedly sought a historiographical post; he was changed to Vice Director of the Directorate of Agriculture, Attendant of the Heir Apparent, and Compiler in the History Institute, and took part in compiling the Book of Tang.

units.zh: 丁內艱，服除，知制誥。
units.en: He entered mourning for a parent; when mourning ended he was appointed drafter of edicts.
units.literal: He entered mourning for a parent; when mourning ended he was made drafter of edicts.

units.zh: 累遷中書舍人、諫議大夫、給事中，復為修撰。
units.en: He rose through successive posts to secretariat drafter, remonstrance official, and palace attendant, and again served as a compiler.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Secretariat Drafter, Remonstrance Official, and Palace Attendant, and again became a compiler.

units.zh: 漢隱帝時，詔與王伸、竇儼等同修晉高祖、出帝、漢高祖實錄。
units.en: Under Later Han's Hidden Emperor, an edict ordered him, together with Wang Shen and Dou Yan and others, to compile the Veritable Records of the Jin high ancestor, the deposed emperor, and Han Gaozu.
units.literal: In the time of the Hidden Emperor of Han, an edict ordered him, together with Wang Shen and Dou Yan and others, to compile the Veritable Records of the Jin high ancestor, the deposed emperor, and Han Gaozu.

units.zh: 初，桑維翰為相，常惡緯為人，待之甚薄。
units.en: Earlier, when Sang Weihan was chief minister, he had always disliked Wei's character and treated him very coldly.
units.literal: Earlier when Sang Weihan was chief minister he had always disliked Wei's character and treated him very coldly.

units.zh: 緯為維翰傳，言「繼翰死，有銀八千鋌。」
units.en: Wei wrote Weihan's biography, stating that "when Weihan died there were eight thousand ingots of silver."
units.literal: Wei wrote Weihan's biography, saying "When Weihan died there were eight thousand ingots of silver."

units.zh: 翰林學士徐臺符以為不可，數以非緯，緯不得已，更為數千鋌。
units.en: The Hanlin academician Xu Taifu objected that this was unacceptable and repeatedly criticized Wei, who had no choice but to reduce the figure to several thousand ingots.
units.literal: The Hanlin academician Xu Taifu thought this unacceptable and repeatedly objected to Wei; Wei had no choice but to change it to several thousand ingots.

units.zh: 廣順元年，實錄成，緯求遷官不得，由是怨望。
units.en: In the first year of Guangshun the Veritable Records were completed; Wei sought promotion and was denied, and from this he nursed resentment.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangshun the Veritable Records were completed; Wei sought promotion and did not obtain it, and from this nursed resentment.

units.zh: 是時，宰相王峻監修國史，緯書日曆，多言當時大臣過失，峻見之，怒曰：「賈給事子弟仕宦亦要門閥，奈何歷詆當朝之士，使其子孫何以仕進？」
units.en: At that time chief minister Wang Jun supervised the national history; Wei wrote the court calendar and recorded many faults of the leading ministers of the day; when Jun saw it he said in anger, "Palace Attendant Jia's sons and brothers also seek office through eminent families—why vilify the men of this court so that their descendants cannot advance?"
units.literal: At that time the chief minister Wang Jun supervised the compilation of the national history; Wei wrote the calendar and spoke much of the faults of the great ministers of the day; when Jun saw it he said in anger: "Palace Attendant Jia's sons and younger brothers also seek office through eminent families—why slander the men of the present court so that their descendants may have no way to advance?"

units.zh: 言之太祖，貶平盧軍行軍司馬。
units.en: He reported this to Taizu, and Wei was demoted to acting military administrator of the Pinglu army.
units.literal: He reported this to Taizu, and Wei was demoted to acting military administrator of the Pinglu Army.

units.zh: 明年卒於青州。
units.en: The following year he died at Qingzhou.
units.literal: The next year he died at Qing Prefecture.

units.zh: 段希堯
units.en: Duan Xiyao
units.literal: Duan Xiyao

units.zh: 段希堯，河內人也。
units.en: Duan Xiyao was a native of Henei.
units.literal: Duan Xiyao was a man of Henei.

units.zh: 晉高祖為河東節度使，以希堯為判官。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang was military commissioner of Hedong, he appointed Xiyao his administrative aide.
units.literal: When the Jin high ancestor was military commissioner of Hedong, he made Xiyao his administrative aide.

units.zh: 高祖軍屯忻州，軍中有擁高祖呼萬歲者，高祖惶惑，不知所為。
units.en: Shi Jingtang's army was encamped at Xinzhou when some soldiers began shouting "Long live the emperor"; he was alarmed and unsure how to respond.
units.literal: The high ancestor's army was stationed at Xin Prefecture; in the army someone led the crowd in shouting "Long live" to the high ancestor; the high ancestor was fearful and did not know what to do.

units.zh: 希堯勸高祖斬其亂首，乃止。
units.en: Xiyao urged him to execute the ringleaders, and the disturbance ceased.
units.literal: Xiyao urged the high ancestor to behead the ringleaders of the disturbance, and it stopped.

units.zh: 高祖將舉兵太原，與其賓佐謀，希堯以為不可，高祖雖不聽，然重其為人，不責之也。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang was about to raise troops at Taiyuan and consulted his staff, Xiyao advised against it; though Jingtang did not listen, he still respected Xiyao's character and did not reproach him.
units.literal: When the high ancestor was about to raise troops at Taiyuan and consulted with his staff, Xiyao held it inadvisable; though the high ancestor did not heed him, he still valued his character and did not blame him.

units.zh: 高祖入立，希堯比諸將吏，恩澤最薄。
units.en: After Jingtang took the throne, Xiyao received fewer rewards than any of the generals and officials.
units.literal: When the high ancestor took the throne, compared with the generals and officials Xiyao received the thinnest favors.

units.zh: 久之，稍遷諫議大夫，使於吳越。
units.en: After some time he was promoted to remonstrance official and sent as envoy to Wu and Yue.
units.literal: After a long time he was gradually promoted to Remonstrance Official and sent as envoy to Wu and Yue.

units.zh: 是時，江、淮不通，凡使吳越者皆泛海，而多風波之患。
units.en: At that time travel along the Yangtze and Huai was cut off; envoys to Wu and Yue had to go by sea, and many were lost to storms.
units.literal: At that time the Yangtze and Huai were not open to travel; all envoys to Wu and Yue went by sea, and many suffered the peril of wind and waves.

units.zh: 希堯過海，遭大風，左右皆恐懼，希堯曰：「吾平生不欺，汝等恃吾，可無恐也。」
units.en: Xiyao crossed the sea and met a violent storm; his companions were terrified, but Xiyao said, "I have never deceived anyone in my life—you may trust me and need not fear."
units.literal: Xiyao crossed the sea and met a great storm; those around him were all afraid; Xiyao said: "I have never deceived others in my life—you may rely on me and need not fear."

units.zh: 已而風亦止。
units.en: Before long the wind died down as well.
units.literal: Presently the wind also ceased.

units.zh: 歷萊、懷、棣三州刺史。
units.en: He served in succession as prefect of Lai, Huai, and Di.
units.literal: He served in succession as prefect of Lai, Huai, and Di.

units.zh: 出帝時，為吏部侍郎，判東、西銓事，累遷禮部尚書。
units.en: Under the deposed emperor he was vice minister of personnel and oversaw the eastern and western selection boards; he rose to minister of rites.
units.literal: In the time of the deposed emperor he was Vice Minister of the Ministry of Personnel and judged the eastern and western selection boards; he was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 卒，年七十九，贈太子少保。
units.en: He died at seventy-nine and was posthumously honored as junior guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He died at seventy-nine and was posthumously honored as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 張允，鎮州人也。
units.en: Zhang Yun was a native of Zhenzhou.
units.literal: Zhang Yun was a man of Zhen Prefecture.

units.zh: 少事鎮州為張文禮參軍。
units.en: As a youth he served in Zhenzhou as an aide to Zhang Wenli.
units.literal: In youth he served Zhen Prefecture as an aide to Zhang Wenli.

units.zh: 唐莊宗討張文禮，允脫身降，莊宗系之獄，文禮敗，乃出之為魏州功曹。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang campaigned against Zhang Wenli, Yun slipped away to surrender; Zhuangzong imprisoned him, but after Wenli's defeat released him and appointed him merit officer of Weizhou.
units.literal: When Tang Zhuangzong campaigned against Zhang Wenli, Yun slipped away to surrender; Zhuangzong put him in prison; when Wenli was defeated he was released and made merit officer of Wei Prefecture.

units.zh: 趙在禮辟節度推官，歷滄、兗二鎮掌書記。
units.en: Zhao Zaili recruited him as legal officer of the military commission; he served in succession as chief secretary in the Cang and Yan commands.
units.literal: Zhao Zaili recruited him as legal officer of the military commission; he served as chief secretary in the Cang and Yan commands in succession.

units.zh: 入為監察御史，累遷水部員外郎，知制誥。
units.en: He entered court service as investigating censor and rose to vice director of the ministry of works and drafter of edicts.
units.literal: He entered court as Investigating Censor and was repeatedly promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts.

units.zh: 廢帝皇子重美為河南尹，掌六軍，以允剛介，乃拜允給事中，為六軍判官。
units.en: The deposed emperor's son Li Chongmei was director of Henan and commanded the Six Armies; because Yun was upright and firm he was appointed palace attendant and judge of the Six Armies.
units.literal: The deposed emperor's son Li Chongmei was Director of Henan and commanded the Six Armies; because Yun was upright and firm he was appointed Palace Attendant and judge of the Six Armies.

units.zh: 罷，遷左散騎常侍。
units.en: When he left that post he was promoted to left regular attendant.
units.literal: When he left office he was promoted to Left Regular Attendant.

units.zh: 晉高祖即位，屢赦天下，允為《駁赦論》以獻曰：「管子曰：『凡赦者小利而大害，久而不勝其禍；
units.en: When Shi Jingtang took the throne he repeatedly proclaimed general amnesties; Yun presented a "Refutation of Amnesty," saying: "Guanzi says, 'Amnesties bring small benefit and great harm; in the long run their harm cannot be overcome;
units.literal: When the Jin high ancestor took the throne he repeatedly amnestied the realm; Yun presented a "Refutation of Amnesty" saying: "Guanzi said: 'Amnesties are a small benefit and a great harm; in the long run their calamity cannot be overcome;

units.zh: 無赦者小害而大利，久而不勝其福。』
units.en: where there is no amnesty there is small harm and great benefit; in the long run its blessing cannot be overcome.'
units.literal: where there is no amnesty there is small harm and great benefit; in the long run its blessing cannot be overcome.'

units.zh: 又漢之吳漢疾篤，帝問漢所欲言。
units.en: He also cited Wu Han of the Han, who on his deathbed was asked what he wished to say.
units.literal: Moreover when Wu Han of Han was gravely ill, the emperor asked what Han wished to say.

units.zh: 漢曰：『惟願陛下無赦爾！』
units.en: Han replied, "I only wish Your Majesty would never proclaim amnesties!"
units.literal: Han said: "I only wish Your Majesty would grant no amnesties!"

units.zh: 蓋行赦不以為恩，不行赦不以為無恩，罰有罪故也。
units.en: Granting amnesty is not true grace, and withholding it is not cruelty—it is because punishment belongs to the guilty.
units.literal: For to grant amnesty is not to show grace, and not to grant amnesty is not to show lack of grace—it is because punishment is for the guilty.

units.zh: 自古皆以水旱則降德音而宥過，開狴牢而出囚，冀感天心以救其災者，非也。
units.en: Since antiquity rulers facing flood or drought have issued edicts of virtue, pardoned offenses, and opened prisons, hoping to move Heaven's heart and end the disaster—but this is mistaken.
units.literal: From antiquity it has been that in flood or drought an edict of virtue is issued and offenses pardoned, prisons opened and prisoners released, hoping to move Heaven's heart to save the calamity—this is wrong.

units.zh: 假有二人之訟者，一有罪而一無罪，若有罪者見舍，則無罪者銜冤。
units.en: Suppose two men are in litigation, one guilty and one innocent; if the guilty is pardoned, the innocent is wronged.
units.literal: Suppose two men are in litigation, one guilty and one innocent; if the guilty man is pardoned, the innocent man harbors grievance.

units.zh: 此乃致災之道，非救災之術也。
units.en: That is how calamity is invited, not how it is averted.
units.literal: This is the way to bring on calamity, not the art of relieving it.

units.zh: 至使小人遇天災，則皆喜而相勸以為惡，曰：『國將赦矣，必舍我以救災。』
units.en: It even teaches petty men, when disaster strikes, to rejoice and urge one another to evil, saying, "The state will soon grant an amnesty—we are sure to be released to end the disaster."
units.literal: It even makes petty men, when they meet with Heaven's calamity, all rejoice and urge one another to do evil, saying: "The state is about to grant an amnesty—we are sure to be released to relieve the calamity."

units.zh: 如此，則是教民為惡也。
units.en: In this way the people are taught to do evil.
units.literal: In this way the people are taught to do evil.

units.zh: 夫天之為道，福善而禍淫。
units.en: Heaven's way is to bless the good and punish the wicked.
units.literal: Heaven's way is to bless the good and punish the wicked.

units.zh: 若舍惡人而變災為福，則是天又喜人為惡也。
units.en: If the wicked are pardoned and disaster turned to blessing, then Heaven would delight in evil.
units.literal: If the wicked are pardoned and calamity is turned into blessing, then Heaven also delights in men doing evil.

units.zh: 凡天之降災，所以警戒人主節嗜欲，務勤儉，恤鰥寡，正刑罰而已。」
units.en: When Heaven sends calamity, it warns the ruler to restrain his appetites, practice diligence and frugality, care for widows and orphans, and correct punishments—that is all."
units.literal: Whenever Heaven sends calamity, it is to warn the ruler to restrain appetites, practice diligence and frugality, show pity to widows and orphans, and correct punishments—that is all."

units.zh: 是時，晉高祖方好臣下有言，覽之大喜。
units.en: At that time Shi Jingtang welcomed outspoken ministers; he read it with great delight.
units.literal: At that time the Jin high ancestor was just then fond of ministers who spoke out; he read it with great delight.

units.zh: 允事漢為吏部侍郎，隱帝誅戮大臣，京師皆恐，允常退朝不敢還家，止於相國寺。
units.en: Yun served the Later Han as vice minister of personnel; when the Hidden Emperor executed senior ministers, the capital was terrified; Yun often dared not go home after court and stayed at the Xiangguo Temple.
units.literal: Yun served Han as Vice Minister of Personnel; when the Hidden Emperor executed great ministers, the capital was all in fear; Yun after leaving court often dared not return home and stopped at the Xiangguo Temple.

units.zh: 周太祖以兵入京師，允匿於佛殿承塵，墜而卒，年六十五。
units.en: When Later Zhou Taizu marched into the capital, Yun hid in the dust layer above a Buddha hall, fell, and died at sixty-five.
units.literal: When Zhou Taizu entered the capital with troops, Yun hid in the dust layer of a Buddha hall, fell, and died at sixty-five.

units.zh: 王松，父徽，為唐僖宗宰相。
units.en: Wang Song's father Hui had been a chief minister under Emperor Xizong of Tang.
units.literal: Wang Song's father Hui was a chief minister under Tang Emperor Xizong.

units.zh: 松舉進士，後唐時，歷刑部郎中，唐末，從事方鎮。
units.en: Song passed the jinshi examination; under Later Tang he served as bureau director in the Ministry of Justice, and at the end of Tang worked for a regional command.
units.literal: Song passed the jinshi examination; in Later Tang he served as Bureau Director in the Ministry of Justice; at the end of Tang he served a regional command.

units.zh: 晉高祖鎮太原，辟松節度判官。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang governed Taiyuan he recruited Song as military administrator of the command.
units.literal: When Jin Gaozu governed Taiyuan he recruited Song as military administrator of the command.

units.zh: 晉高祖即位，拜右諫議大夫，累拜工部尚書。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang took the throne he appointed Song right remonstrance grand master and eventually minister of works.
units.literal: When Jin Gaozu took the throne he appointed Song Right Remonstrance Grand Master and repeatedly promoted him to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 出帝北遷，蕭翰立許王從益於京師，以松為左丞相。
units.en: When the Deposed Emperor was taken north, Xiao Han installed Prince Xu Congyi at the capital and appointed Song left chancellor.
units.literal: When the Deposed Emperor was moved north, Xiao Han installed Prince Xu Congyi in the capital and made Song left chancellor.

units.zh: 漢高祖入洛，先遣人馳詔東京百官嘗授偽命者皆焚之，使勿自疑，由是御史臺悉斂百官偽敕焚之。
units.en: When Later Han Gaozu entered Luoyang he first sent urgent edicts to the eastern capital ordering officials who had accepted Khitan appointments to burn those documents and put their minds at ease; the Censorate accordingly collected and burned the officials' false commissions.
units.literal: When Han Gaozu entered Luoyang he first sent men with urgent edicts ordering that the eastern capital officials who had once accepted false appointments all burn them so they should not doubt themselves; on this account the Censorate collected and burned all the officials' false commissions.

units.zh: 松以手指其胸，引郭子儀自誚，以語人曰：「此乃二十四考中書令也。」
units.en: Song pointed at his chest, alluding to Guo Ziyi in self-mockery, and told others, "Here is a chief minister with twenty-four annual reviews to his credit."
units.literal: Song pointed at his chest, citing Guo Ziyi in self-mockery, and said to people: "This is a chief minister who held office through twenty-four annual reviews."

units.zh: 聞者笑之。
units.en: Those who heard laughed.
units.literal: Those who heard laughed at him.

units.zh: 後松子仁寶為李守貞河中支使，守貞反，松以子故上書自陳，高祖憐之，但使解職而已。
units.en: Later Song's son Renbao served as branch commissioner under Li Shouzhen at Hezhong; when Shouzhen rebelled, Song memorialized in his own defense because of his son; Gaozu took pity on him and merely had him relieved of office.
units.literal: Later Song's son Renbao served as branch commissioner for Li Shouzhen in Hezhong; when Shouzhen rebelled, Song because of his son submitted a memorial explaining himself; Gaozu pitied him and only had him relieved of office.

units.zh: 松有田城東，歲時往來京師，以疾卒。
units.en: Song owned farmland east of the city and traveled to and from the capital each year; he died of illness.
units.literal: Song had farmland east of the city and each year traveled back and forth to the capital; he died of illness.

units.zh: 裴皞，字司東，河東人也。
units.en: Pei Hao, styled Sidong, was a native of Hedong.
units.literal: Pei Hao, styled Sidong, was a man of Hedong.

units.zh: 裴氏自晉、魏以來，世為名族，居燕者號「東眷」，居涼者號「西眷」，居河東者號「中眷」。
units.en: The Pei clan had been an eminent family since the Jin and Wei dynasties; those in Yan were called the "Eastern Branch," those in Liang the "Western Branch," and those in Hedong the "Central Branch."
units.literal: The Pei clan from Jin and Wei onward for generations were an eminent house; those dwelling in Yan were called the "Eastern Branch," those in Liang the "Western Branch," and those in Hedong the "Central Branch."

units.zh: 皞出於名家，而容止端秀，性剛急，直而無隱。
units.en: Hao came from a distinguished family; he was refined in bearing and handsome in appearance, stern and quick-tempered, upright and blunt.
units.literal: Hao came from a famous family; his bearing and deportment were refined and handsome; his nature was stern and quick, upright and without concealment.

units.zh: 少好學，唐光化中舉進士，拜校書郎、拾遺、補闕。
units.en: He loved learning from youth; in the Tang Guanghua era he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed collator, remonstrance official, and supplementation official.
units.literal: In youth he loved learning; in the Guanghua era of Tang he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed collator, Reminder, and Supplementation Official.

units.zh: 事梁為翰林學士、中書舍人。
units.en: He served the Liang as Hanlin academician and secretariat drafter.
units.literal: He served Liang as Hanlin academician and Secretariat Drafter.

units.zh: 事後唐為禮部侍郎。
units.en: He served Later Tang as vice minister of rites.
units.literal: He served Later Tang as Vice Minister of Rites.

units.zh: 皞喜論議，每陳朝廷闕失，多斥權臣。
units.en: Hao loved debate and often criticized the court's failings, denouncing powerful ministers.
units.literal: Hao delighted in discussion and whenever he set forth the court's failings often denounced powerful ministers.

units.zh: 改太子賓客，以老拜兵部尚書致仕。
units.en: He was made mentor of the heir apparent; in old age he was appointed minister of war and retired.
units.literal: He was changed to Mentor of the Heir Apparent; in old age he was appointed Minister of War and retired.

units.zh: 晉高祖起為工部尚書，復以老告，拜右僕射致仕。
units.en: Shi Jingtang recalled him as minister of works; he again pleaded old age and was appointed right vice director of the Department of State Affairs and retired.
units.literal: The Jin high ancestor recalled him as Minister of Works; he again pleaded old age and was appointed Right Vice Director of the Department of State Affairs and retired.

units.zh: 卒，年八十五，贈太子太保。
units.en: He died at eighty-five and was posthumously honored as grand guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He died at eighty-five and was posthumously honored as Grand Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 皞以文學在朝廷久，宰相馬胤孫、桑維翰，皆皞禮部所放進士也。
units.en: Hao had long served at court through his literary accomplishments; chief ministers Ma Yinsun and Sang Weihan were both jinshi graduates he had passed in the Ministry of Rites.
units.literal: Hao by his literary accomplishments had long been in court; the chief ministers Ma Yinsun and Sang Weihan were both jinshi graduates whom Hao had passed in the Ministry of Rites.

units.zh: 後胤孫知舉，放榜，引新進士詣皞，皞喜作詩曰：「門生門下見門生。」
units.en: Later Yinsun conducted the examinations; when the list was posted he led the new jinshi to call on Hao; Hao joyfully composed a poem: "Among my students I see my students."
units.literal: Later Yinsun was in charge of the examinations; when the list was posted he led the new jinshi to call on Hao; Hao joyfully composed a poem saying: "Among my students I see my students."

units.zh: 世傳以為榮。
units.en: The line was celebrated as a mark of honor.
units.literal: The world passed it around as an honor.

units.zh: 維翰已作相，嘗過皞，皞不迎不送。
units.en: Weihan had already become chief minister and once visited Hao's home; Hao neither welcomed him nor saw him off.
units.literal: Weihan had already become chief minister and once passed by Hao's residence; Hao neither went out to welcome nor saw him off.

units.zh: 人或問之，皞曰：「我見桑公於中書，庶寮也；
units.en: When someone asked why, Hao said, "When I saw Lord Sang at the Secretariat he was a subordinate;
units.literal: When someone asked him, Hao said: "When I saw Lord Sang at the Secretariat he was a subordinate official;

units.zh: 桑公見我於私第，門生也。
units.en: when Lord Sang visited me at home I was his teacher.
units.literal: when Lord Sang saw me at my private residence I was his teacher.

units.zh: 何送迎之有？」
units.en: Why should there be welcome or send-off?"
units.literal: What welcome or send-off is there?"

units.zh: 人亦以為當。
units.en: People agreed he was right.
units.literal: People also thought it fitting.

units.zh: 王仁裕
units.en: Wang Renyu
units.literal: Wang Renyu

units.zh: 王仁裕，字德輦，天水人也。
units.en: Wang Renyu, styled Dening, was a native of Tianshui.
units.literal: Wang Renyu, styled Dening, was a man of Tianshui.

units.zh: 少不知書，以狗馬彈射為樂，年二十五始就學，而為人俊秀，以文辭知名秦、隴間。
units.en: As a youth he knew no books and amused himself with dogs, horses, and archery; at twenty-five he began to study, yet he was handsome and refined and became known in Qin and Long for his writing.
units.literal: In youth he did not know books and took his pleasure in dogs, horses, archery, and shooting; at twenty-five he first undertook study, yet as a man he was handsome and refined and became known in Qin and Long for his literary compositions.

units.zh: 秦帥辟為秦州節度判官。
units.en: The military governor of Qin recruited him as administrative aide of the Qinzhou command.
units.literal: The commander of Qin recruited him as administrative aide of the Qinzhou military commission.

units.zh: 秦州入於蜀，仁裕因事蜀為中書舍人、翰林學士。
units.en: When Qinzhou fell to Shu, Renyu entered Shu service as secretariat drafter and Hanlin academician.
units.literal: When Qin Prefecture fell to Shu, Renyu followed the affair and served Shu as Secretariat Drafter and Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 唐莊宗平蜀，仁裕事唐，復為秦州節度判官。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang pacified Shu, Renyu returned to Tang service as administrative aide of the Qinzhou command.
units.literal: When Tang Zhuangzong pacified Shu, Renyu served Tang and again became administrative aide of the Qinzhou military commission.

units.zh: 王思同鎮興元，辟為從事。
units.en: Wang Sitong governed Xingyuan and recruited him as an aide.
units.literal: Wang Sitong governed Xingyuan and recruited him as an aide.

units.zh: 思同留守西京，以為判官。
units.en: When Sitong remained at the western capital as regent, he made Renyu his administrative aide.
units.literal: When Sitong remained at the western capital as regent, he made Renyu his administrative aide.

units.zh: 廢帝舉兵鳳翔，思同戰敗，廢帝得仁裕，聞其名不殺，置之軍中。
units.en: The deposed emperor raised troops at Fengxiang; Sitong was defeated; the deposed emperor took Renyu captive, heard his reputation, spared his life, and kept him in the army.
units.literal: The deposed emperor raised troops at Fengxiang; Sitong was defeated in battle; the deposed emperor obtained Renyu; hearing his name he did not kill him and placed him in the army.

units.zh: 自廢帝起事，至其入立，馳檄諸鎮，詔書、告命皆仁裕為之。
units.en: From the deposed emperor's uprising until his enthronement, all urgent dispatches, edicts, and appointments were drafted by Renyu.
units.literal: From the time the deposed emperor began his undertaking until he took the throne, urgent dispatches to the commands and imperial edicts and appointments were all written by Renyu.

units.zh: 久之，以都官郎中充翰林學士。
units.en: After some time he was made attendant of the directorate of the imperial clan and concurrently Hanlin academician.
units.literal: After a long time he was made Attendant of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan and concurrently Hanlin academician.

units.zh: 晉高祖入立，罷職為郎中，歷司封左司郎中、諫議大夫。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang took the throne he was reduced to attendant; he served in succession as attendant of the directorate of the imperial clan, left attendant of the left secretariat, and remonstrance official.
units.literal: When the Jin high ancestor took the throne he was dismissed to Attendant; he served in succession as Attendant of the Directorate of the Imperial Clan, Left Attendant of the Left Secretariat, and Remonstrance Official.

units.zh: 漢高祖時，復為翰林學士承旨，累遷戶部尚書，罷為兵部尚書、太子少保。
units.en: Under Later Han Gaozu he again became chief Hanlin academician and rose to minister of revenue; he was later dismissed as minister of war and junior guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: In the time of Han Gaozu he again became Chief Hanlin academician and was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Revenue; he was dismissed as Minister of War and Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 顯德三年卒，年七十七，贈太子少師。
units.en: He died in the third year of Xiande at seventy-seven and was posthumously honored as junior preceptor of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He died in the third year of Xiande at seventy-seven and was posthumously honored as Junior Preceptor of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 仁裕性曉音律，晉高祖初定雅樂，宴群臣於永福殿，奏黃鐘，仁裕聞之曰：「音不純肅而無和聲，當有爭者起於禁中。」
units.en: Renyu had a keen ear for music; when Shi Jingtang first fixed the court music and feasted his ministers at Yongfu Hall, the yellow bell pitch was played; Renyu said, "The tone is impure and lacks harmony—strife will arise within the palace."
units.literal: Renyu was by nature skilled in musical pitch; when the Jin high ancestor first fixed the elegant music and feasted the ministers at Yongfu Hall, they performed the yellow bell pitch; Renyu heard it and said: "The tone is not pure and solemn and lacks harmony—there will be contention arising within the palace."

units.zh: 已而兩軍校斗升龍門外，聲聞於內，人以為神。
units.en: Soon two military officers fought outside Longmen Gate; the clamor was heard inside the palace, and people took him for a prophet.
units.literal: Presently two military officers fought at Longmen Gate outside; the sound was heard within; people regarded him as divine.

units.zh: 喜為詩。
units.en: He loved composing poetry.
units.literal: He delighted in composing poetry.

units.zh: 其少也，嘗夢剖其腸胃，以西江水滌之，顧見江中沙石皆為篆籀之文，由是文思益進。
units.en: In youth he dreamed his bowels were cut open and washed in the waters of the West River; looking back he saw sand and stones in the river written in seal and clerical script; from this his literary inspiration grew sharper.
units.literal: In his youth he once dreamed that his entrails were cut open and washed with the waters of the West River; looking back he saw that the sand and stones in the river were all characters in seal and clerical script; from this his literary thought advanced further.

units.zh: 乃集其平生所作詩萬餘首為百卷，號《西江集》。
units.en: He collected more than ten thousand poems of his lifetime into a hundred juan titled Collected Poems of the West River.
units.literal: He then collected the poems of his lifetime, more than ten thousand in all, in a hundred juan, titled Collected Poems of the West River.

units.zh: 仁裕與和凝於五代時皆以文章知名，又嘗知貢舉，仁裕門生王溥、凝門生範質，皆至宰相，時稱其得人。
units.en: Renyu and He Ning were both famed for literature in the Five Dynasties era; each had also conducted the examinations; Renyu's student Wang Pu and Ning's student Fan Zhi both became chief ministers, and their contemporaries praised their judgment of talent.
units.literal: Renyu and He Ning in the Five Dynasties period were both renowned for literary accomplishment; each had also conducted the examinations; Renyu's student Wang Pu and Ning's student Fan Zhi both reached the chief ministership, and the age praised them for choosing men well.

units.zh: 裴羽，字用化，其父贄，相唐僖宗，官至司空。
units.en: Pei Yu, styled Yonghua, was the son of Zan, who served as chief minister to Emperor Xizong of Tang and rose to director of works.
units.literal: Pei Yu, styled Yonghua, his father Zan served as chief minister to Tang Emperor Xizong and reached the post of Director of Works.

units.zh: 羽以一品子為河南壽安尉。
units.en: As the son of a first-rank official, Yu was appointed sheriff of Shou'an in Henan.
units.literal: Yu as the son of a first-rank official was made Wei of Shou'an in Henan.

units.zh: 事梁為御史臺主簿，改監察御史。
units.en: He served the Liang as chief clerk of the censorate and was promoted to investigating censor.
units.literal: He served Liang as chief clerk of the Censorate and was changed to Investigating Censor.

units.zh: 唐明宗時，為吏部郎中，與右散騎常侍陸崇使於閩，為海風所飄至錢塘。
units.en: Under Mingzong of Tang he was director of the ministry of personnel and, with right regular attendant Lu Chong, was sent as envoy to Min; a sea storm drove them to Qiantang.
units.literal: In the time of Tang Mingzong he was Director of the Ministry of Personnel and, together with Right Regular Attendant Lu Chong, was sent as envoy to Min; they were blown by a sea wind to Qiantang.

units.zh: 是時，吳越王錢镠與安重誨有隙，唐方絕镠朝貢，羽等被留經歲，而崇以疾卒。
units.en: At that time King Qian Liu of Wu and Yue was at odds with An Chonghui; the Tang court had just cut off his tribute missions; Yu and his party were detained for a year, and Chong died of illness.
units.literal: At that time the King of Wu and Yue Qian Liu had a rift with An Chonghui; Tang had just cut off Liu's tribute missions; Yu and the others were detained for a year, and Chong died of illness.

units.zh: 後镠遣羽還，羽求載崇屍與俱歸。
units.en: Later Liu sent Yu back; Yu asked to take Chong's body home with him.
units.literal: Later Liu sent Yu back; Yu asked to carry Chong's corpse home with him.

units.zh: 镠初不許，羽以語感動镠，镠惻然許之，因附羽表自歸。
units.en: At first Liu refused; Yu's words moved him to pity, and Liu consented and attached to Yu a memorial submitting himself to the Tang court.
units.literal: At first Liu did not consent; Yu moved him with his words; Liu was moved to pity and consented, and therefore attached to Yu a memorial submitting himself to the court.

units.zh: 明宗得镠表大喜，由是吳越復通於中國。
units.en: Mingzong received Liu's memorial with great joy, and from that time Wu and Yue resumed contact with the central court.
units.literal: Mingzong received Liu's memorial with great joy, and from this Wu and Yue again had communication with the central state.

units.zh: 羽護崇喪至京師，及其橐裝還其家，士人皆多羽之義。
units.en: Yu escorted Chong's coffin to the capital and returned his belongings to his family; scholars admired Yu's sense of duty.
units.literal: Yu escorted Chong's coffin to the capital and also returned his baggage to his family; gentlemen all admired Yu's righteousness.

units.zh: 羽，周太祖時為左散騎常侍，卒，贈戶部尚書。
units.en: Under Later Zhou Taizu he was left regular attendant; he died and was posthumously honored as minister of revenue.
units.literal: Yu in the time of Zhou Taizu was Left Regular Attendant; he died and was posthumously honored as Minister of Revenue.

units.zh: 王延，字世美，鄭州長豐人也。
units.en: Wang Yan, styled Shimei, was a native of Changfeng in Zhengzhou.
units.literal: Wang Yan, styled Shimei, was a man of Changfeng in Zheng Prefecture.

units.zh: 少好學，嘗以賦謁梁相李琪，琪為之稱譽，薦為即墨縣令。
units.en: He loved learning from youth; he once presented a fu to the Liang chief minister Li Qi, who praised him and recommended him as magistrate of Jimo.
units.literal: In youth he loved learning; he once presented a fu to Liang chief minister Li Qi, who praised him and recommended him as magistrate of Jimo.

units.zh: 馮道作相，與延故人，召拜左補闕。
units.en: When Feng Dao became chief minister, as an old acquaintance of Yan he summoned him and appointed him left supplementation official.
units.literal: When Feng Dao became chief minister, being an old acquaintance of Yan he summoned and appointed him Left Supplementation Official.

units.zh: 遷水部員外郎，知制誥。
units.en: He was promoted to vice director of the ministry of works and drafter of edicts.
units.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Ministry of Works and drafter of edicts.

units.zh: 拜中書舍人，權知貢舉。
units.en: He was appointed secretariat drafter and given provisional charge of the examinations.
units.literal: He was appointed Secretariat Drafter and given provisional charge of the examinations.

units.zh: 吏部尚書盧文紀與故相崔協有隙。
units.en: Minister of personnel Lu Wenji bore a grudge against the former chief minister Cui Xie.
units.literal: Minister of Personnel Lu Wenji had a grudge against the former chief minister Cui Xie.

units.zh: 是時，協子頎方舉進士，文紀謂延曰：「吾嘗譽子於朝，貢舉選士，當求實效，無以虛名取人。
units.en: At that time Xie's son Qi was taking the jinshi examination; Wenji told Yan, "I once praised your son at court; in selecting candidates one should seek real merit and not take men on empty reputation.
units.literal: At that time Xie's son Qi was taking the jinshi examination; Wenji said to Yan: "I once praised your son at court; in selecting scholars for the examinations one should seek real achievement and not take men on empty reputation.

units.zh: 昔有越人善泅，生子方晬，其母浮之水上。
units.en: There was once a man of Yue skilled at swimming; when his son was a month old his mother floated him on the water.
units.literal: Formerly there was a man of Yue skilled at swimming; when his son was a month old his mother floated him on the water.

units.zh: 人怪而問之，則曰：『其父善泅，子必能之。』
units.en: People marveled and asked why; she said, 'His father swims well—the son is sure to swim as well.'
units.literal: People marveled and asked why; she said: 'His father is skilled at swimming—the son will surely be able to do it.'

units.zh: 若是可乎？」
units.en: Would that be acceptable?"
units.literal: Would that be acceptable?"

units.zh: 延退而笑曰：「盧公之言，為崔協也，恨其父遂及其子邪！」
units.en: Yan withdrew and laughed, "Lord Lu's words are aimed at Cui Xie—does he hate the father and therefore punish the son?"
units.literal: Yan withdrew and laughed, saying: "Lord Lu's words are aimed at Cui Xie—does he hate the father and therefore reach to the son?"

units.zh: 明年，選頎甲科，人皆稱其公。
units.en: The next year he placed Qi in the top grade of the jinshi; everyone praised his fairness.
units.literal: The next year he selected Qi in the top grade of the jinshi; people all praised his fairness.

units.zh: 累遷刑部尚書，以太子少保致仕。
units.en: He rose to minister of punishments and retired as junior guardian of the heir apparent.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Minister of Punishments and retired as Junior Guardian of the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 卒，年七十三。
units.en: He died at seventy-three.
units.literal: He died at seventy-three.

units.zh: 延為人重然諾，與其弟規相友愛，五代之際，稱其家法焉。
units.en: Yan greatly valued his word; he and his younger brother Gui were deeply affectionate; in the Five Dynasties era their family conduct was widely praised.
units.literal: Yan as a man greatly valued his promises; he and his younger brother Gui were mutually affectionate; in the Five Dynasties period their family ways were praised.

units.zh: ○馬重績
units.en: Ma Zhongji
units.literal: ○ Ma Zhongji

units.zh: 馬重績，字洞微，其先出於北狄，而世事軍中。
units.en: Ma Zhongji, styled Dongwei, was descended from the northern Di and for generations his family served in the military.
units.literal: Ma Zhongji, styled Dongwei, his ancestors came from the northern Di and for generations served in the army.

units.zh: 重績少學數術，明太一、五紀、八象、《三統大曆》，居於太原。
units.en: From youth Zhongji studied numerology and calendrical science; he mastered the Grand Unity, the Five Chronologies, the Eight Images, and the Comprehensive Calendar of the Three Unifications, and lived at Taiyuan.
units.literal: Zhongji in youth studied numerology and the arts of calculation; he understood the Grand Unity, the Five Chronologies, the Eight Images, and the Comprehensive Calendar of the Three Unifications, and dwelt at Taiyuan.

units.zh: 唐莊宗鎮太原，每用兵征伐，必以問之，重績所言無不中，拜大理司直。
units.en: When Emperor Zhuangzong of Tang governed Taiyuan, he consulted Zhongji before every campaign; Zhongji's predictions never failed, and he was appointed directing officer of the Court of Judicial Review.
units.literal: When Tang Zhuangzong governed Taiyuan, whenever he used troops on campaign he always consulted Zhongji; what Zhongji said never missed, and he was appointed Directing Officer of the Court of Judicial Review.

units.zh: 明宗時，廢不用。
units.en: Under Mingzong he was dismissed and went unused.
units.literal: In the time of Mingzong he was dismissed and not employed.

units.zh: 晉高祖以太原拒命，廢帝遣兵圍之，勢甚危急，命重績筮之，遇《同人》，曰：「天火之象，乾建而離明。
units.en: When Shi Jingtang defied the court at Taiyuan, the deposed emperor sent troops to besiege him; the situation was desperate; Jingtang ordered Zhongji to cast the hexagrams and obtained Fellowship; Zhongji said, "This is the image of Heaven and Fire—Qian established and Li bright.
units.literal: When the Jin high ancestor defied orders at Taiyuan, the deposed emperor sent troops to besiege him; the situation was very perilous; he ordered Zhongji to divine by the Changes and obtained Tongren (Fellowship); he said: "It is the image of Heaven and Fire—Qian is established and Li is bright.

units.zh: 健者君之德也，明者南面而向之，所以治天下也。
units.en: Strength is the ruler's virtue; brightness is facing south—by this the realm is governed.
units.literal: Strength is the virtue of the ruler; brightness is facing southward—thereby the realm is governed.

units.zh: 同人者人所同也，必有同我者焉。
units.en: Fellowship means men unite together; there will surely be those who join you.
units.literal: Tongren means that men are in fellowship; there will surely be those who join with me.

units.zh: 《易》曰：『戰乎乾。』
units.en: The Changes says, "Battle in Qian."
units.literal: The Changes says: "Battle in Qian.

units.zh: 乾，西北也。
units.en: Qian is the northwest.
units.literal: Qian is the northwest.

units.zh: 又曰：『相見乎離。』
units.en: It also says, "They meet in Li."
units.literal: It also says: "They meet in Li.

units.zh: 離，南方也。
units.en: Li is the south.
units.literal: Li is the south.

units.zh: 其同我者自北而南乎？
units.en: Will your allies come from the north toward the south?
units.literal: Will those who join with me come from the north toward the south?

units.zh: 乾，西北也，戰而勝，其九月十月之交乎？」
units.en: Qian is the northwest; victory in battle—will it come at the turn of the ninth and tenth months?"
units.literal: Qian is the northwest; victory in battle—will it be at the junction of the ninth and tenth months?"

units.zh: 是歲九月，契丹助晉擊敗唐軍，晉遂有天下。
units.en: That year in the ninth month the Khitan aided Jin and defeated the Tang army; Jin then took the realm.
units.literal: That year in the ninth month the Khitan aided Jin and defeated the Tang army; Jin then possessed the realm.

units.zh: 拜重績太子右贊善大夫，遷司天監。
units.en: Zhongji was appointed right mentor of the heir apparent and promoted to director of the directorate of astronomy.
units.literal: Zhongji was appointed Right Mentor of the Heir Apparent and promoted to Director of the Directorate of Astronomy.

units.zh: 明年，張從賓反，命重績筮之，遇《隨》，曰：「南瞻析木，木不自續，虛而動之，動隨其覆。
units.en: The next year Zhang Congbin rebelled; Jingtang ordered Zhongji to divine and obtained Following; he said, "Looking south at the Divided Wood star, wood cannot sustain itself; though empty it stirs—when it moves it follows to its fall.
units.literal: The next year Zhang Congbin rebelled; he ordered Zhongji to divine and obtained Sui (Following); he said: "Looking south at the Divided Wood star, wood cannot sustain itself; empty yet it moves—when it moves it follows to its overturning.

units.zh: 歲將秋矣，無能為也！」
units.en: The year will reach autumn—he can do nothing!"
units.literal: The year will reach autumn—he can do nothing!"

units.zh: 七月而從賓敗。
units.en: In the seventh month Congbin was defeated.
units.literal: In the seventh month Congbin was defeated.

units.zh: 高祖大喜，賜以良馬、器幣。
units.en: Jingtang was greatly pleased and bestowed fine horses, vessels, and silks.
units.literal: The high ancestor was greatly pleased and bestowed fine horses and vessels and silks.

units.zh: 天福三年，重績上言：「歷象，王者所以正一氣之元，宣萬邦之命。
units.en: In the third year of Tianfu Zhongji memorialized: "The calendar and the stars are what kings use to fix the origin of cosmic order and proclaim the mandate of the myriad states.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianfu Zhongji submitted a memorial saying: "The calendar and the stars are what kings use to rectify the origin of the single qi and proclaim the mandate of the myriad states.

units.zh: 而古今所紀，考審多差，《宣明》氣朔正而星度不驗，《崇玄》五星得而歲差一日，以《宣明》之氣朔，合《崇玄》之五星，二歷相參，然後符合。
units.en: Yet calendars ancient and modern, on examination, contain many errors; the Xuanming calendar had correct qi and new moons but star positions did not verify; the Chongxuan calendar tracked the five planets but erred by a day per year—only by joining Xuanming's qi and new moons with Chongxuan's planetary tables can the two be made to agree.
units.literal: Yet the records of past and present, on examination, contain many errors; the Xuanming calendar had correct qi and new moon but the star positions did not check; the Chongxuan calendar got the five planets right but the annual discrepancy was one day—using the qi and new moon of Xuanming and the five planets of Chongxuan, when the two calendars are joined, then they accord.

units.zh: 自前世諸歷，皆起天正十一月為歲首，用太古甲子為上元，積歲愈多，差闊愈甚。
units.en: Former calendars all began the year at the eleventh month of the celestial standard and used the primordial jiazi of high antiquity as the superior origin; the more years passed, the wider the error grew.
units.literal: From the calendars of former ages, all took the first month of the eleventh month of the celestial standard as the year's head and used the primordial jiazi of high antiquity as the superior origin; the more years accumulated, the wider the discrepancy grew.

units.zh: 臣輒合二歷，創為新法，以唐天寶十四載乙未為上元，雨水正月中氣為氣首。」
units.en: I have joined the two calendars and devised a new method, taking the yiwei year, the fourteenth year of Tang Tianbao, as the superior origin and the mid-qi of the Rain Water month as the head of qi."
units.literal: Your servant has joined the two calendars and created a new method, taking the yiwei year, the fourteenth year of Tianbao of Tang, as the superior origin and the mid-qi of the first month of Rain Water as the head of qi."

units.zh: 詔下司天監趙仁锜、張文皓等考覈得失。
units.en: An edict ordered Zhao Renqi, Zhang Wenhao, and others of the directorate of astronomy to examine its strengths and flaws.
units.literal: An edict was sent down ordering Zhao Renqi, Zhang Wenhao, and others of the Directorate of Astronomy to examine the gains and losses.

units.zh: 仁锜等言：「明年庚子正月朔，用重績歷考之，皆合無舛。」
units.en: Renqi and the others reported, "On the first day of the first month of the coming gengzi year, Zhongji's calendar matches perfectly."
units.literal: Renqi and the others said: "On the first day of the first month of the gengzi year next year, when examined by Zhongji's calendar, all accord without error."

units.zh: 乃下詔班行之，號《調元曆》。
units.en: An edict was issued to promulgate it under the title Calendar for Regulating the Origin.
units.literal: Thereupon an edict was issued to promulgate it, titled the Calendar for Regulating the Origin.

units.zh: 行之數歲輒差，遂不用。
units.en: After a few years discrepancies appeared and it was abandoned.
units.literal: After it was used for several years discrepancies arose and it was no longer used.

units.zh: 重績又言：「漏刻之法，以中星考晝夜為一百刻，八刻六十分刻之二十為一時，時以四刻十分為正，此自古所用也。
units.en: Zhongji also said, "The clepsydra method uses culmination stars to divide day and night into one hundred ke; eight ke and sixty minute-ke make one double-hour; each double-hour takes four ke and ten minutes as the standard—this is the ancient usage.
units.literal: Zhongji also said: "The method of the clepsydra takes the culmination stars to examine day and night as one hundred ke; eight ke and sixty minute-ke make one double-hour; the double-hour takes four ke and ten minutes as the standard—this is what antiquity used.

units.zh: 今失其傳，以午正為時始，下侵未四刻十分而為午。
units.en: The tradition is now lost; noon is taken as the start of the double-hour, encroaching four ke and ten minutes into the wei period to make noon.
units.literal: Now the transmission is lost; noon is taken as the start of the double-hour, encroaching four ke and ten minutes into wei to make noon.

units.zh: 由是晝夜昏曉，皆失其正，請依古改正。」
units.en: Thus day and night, dusk and dawn, all lose their proper measure; I ask that it be corrected according to antiquity."
units.literal: Hence day and night, dusk and dawn, all lose their correctness; I request correction according to antiquity."

units.zh: 從之。
units.en: His proposal was adopted.
units.literal: His proposal was followed.

units.zh: 重績卒年六十四。
units.en: Zhongji died at sixty-four.
units.literal: Zhongji died at sixty-four.

units.zh: 趙延義
units.en: Zhao Yanyi
units.literal: Zhao Yanyi

units.zh: 趙延義，字子英，秦州人也。
units.en: Zhao Yanyi, styled Ziying, was a native of Qinzhou.
units.literal: Zhao Yanyi, styled Ziying, was a man of Qin Prefecture.

units.zh: 曾祖省躬通數術，避亂於蜀。
units.en: His great-grandfather Shenggong was versed in numerology and fled the turmoil to Shu.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Shenggong was versed in numerology and fled the turmoil to Shu.

units.zh: 父溫珪，事蜀王建為司天監，每為建占吉兇，小不中，輒加詰責。
units.en: His father Wengui served Wang Jian of Shu as director of the directorate of astronomy; whenever he divined good or ill fortune for Jian, the slightest error brought harsh rebuke.
units.literal: His father Wengui served Shu's Wang Jian as Director of the Directorate of Astronomy; whenever he divined fortune and misfortune for Jian, if he missed slightly he was harshly rebuked.

units.zh: 溫珪臨卒，戒其子孫曰：「數術，吾世業，然吾仕亂國，得罪而幾死者數矣！
units.en: On his deathbed Wengui admonished his descendants: "Numerology is our family trade, yet I served a chaotic state and several times nearly died for it!
units.literal: On his deathbed Wengui admonished his sons and grandsons: "Numerology is our family profession, yet I served a chaotic state and several times nearly died for my offenses!

units.zh: 子孫能以佗道仕進者，不必為也。」
units.en: If my descendants can advance by another path, they need not follow this trade."
units.literal: If descendants can advance through office by another path, they need not do this."

units.zh: 然延義少亦以此仕蜀為司天監。
units.en: Yet Yanyi in youth also entered office through this art and served Shu as director of the directorate of astronomy.
units.literal: Yet Yanyi in youth also entered office by this art and served Shu as Director of the Directorate of Astronomy.

units.zh: 蜀亡，仕唐為星官。
units.en: When Shu fell he served the Tang as an astral official.
units.literal: When Shu perished he served Tang as an astral official.

units.zh: 延義兼通三式，頗善相人。
units.en: Yanyi was also versed in the Three Styles and skilled at physiognomy.
units.literal: Yanyi was also versed in the Three Styles and quite skilled at physiognomy.

units.zh: 契丹滅晉，延義隨虜至鎮州。
units.en: When the Khitan destroyed Jin, Yanyi followed the captives to Zhenzhou.
units.literal: When the Khitan destroyed Jin, Yanyi followed the captives to Zhen Prefecture.

units.zh: 李筠、白再榮謀逐麻答歸漢，猶豫未決，延義假述數術贊成之。
units.en: Li Yun and Bai Zairong plotted to drive out Mada and return to the Han court; they hesitated; Yanyi, feigning divination, urged them to act.
units.literal: Li Yun and Bai Zairong plotted to drive out Mada and return to Han; they hesitated and could not decide; Yanyi under pretense of numerology urged them to consent.

units.zh: 周太祖自魏以兵入京師，太祖召延義問：「漢祚短促者，天數邪？」
units.en: When Later Zhou Taizu marched into the capital from Wei, he summoned Yanyi and asked, "Was the brevity of the Han mandate due to Heaven's decree?"
units.literal: When Zhou Taizu entered the capital with troops from Wei, Taizu summoned Yanyi and asked: "Was the brevity of Han's mandate due to Heaven's number?"

units.zh: 延義言：「王者撫天下，當以仁恩德澤，而漢法深酷，刑罰枉濫，天下稱冤，此其所以亡也！」
units.en: Yanyi said, "A king who rules the realm should govern with benevolence and grace; but Han law was harsh and cruel, punishments were wrongly applied, and the realm cried out in grievance—that is why it perished!"
units.literal: Yanyi said: "A king who pacifies the realm should use benevolence, grace, and virtue; yet Han law was harsh and cruel, punishments were wrongly applied, and the realm cried out in grievance—this is why it perished!"

units.zh: 是時，太祖方以兵圍蘇逢吉、劉銖第，欲誅其族，聞延義言悚然，因貸其族，二家獲全。
units.en: At that time Taizu was besieging the residences of Su Fengji and Liu Chu, intending to execute their clans; hearing Yanyi's words he was startled, pardoned their families, and both households were spared.
units.literal: At that time Taizu was just then using troops to besiege the residences of Su Fengji and Liu Chu, wishing to execute their clans; hearing Yanyi's words he was startled and therefore pardoned their clans; the two families were preserved whole.

units.zh: 延義事周為太府卿、判司天監，以疾卒。
units.en: Yanyi served Zhou as director of the imperial storehouse and provisional director of the directorate of astronomy; he died of illness.
units.literal: Yanyi served Zhou as Director of the Imperial Storehouse and provisional Director of the Directorate of Astronomy; he died of illness.
